notes: Binary matching leaves S(x)+(S(y)+z) versus S(x+y)+z. AC-matching of the same finite table fails at I+(x)+S(y)+I+(z). Both are the balanced-trit carry of 1+1, the same carry that made D-through-Add unsound and that blocked push-in at D∘S. A complete form is an AC engine with constants or carry. Rules stay out of rewrite._step. The follow-up architectural decision is add_affine_only / BTC-add-affine-only: those identities exhaust the exact constructor table, so sums are affine / coefficient-word only.
statement: Any finite exact-on-ℤ factor-out Add extension of the unary tree core is either semantically incomplete even modulo AC, or already an AC-matching / constant-folding engine (a CAS). So {D, I_a, S, N} remains the maximal complete tree core.
